profile.headline: Industrial Technologist
profile.summary: Developer and designer of industrial web applications, systems, data architectures, dynamic processing and interactive visualizations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Services Engineering
positions.description:
Lead UI engineer for App Analytics within App Store Connect, partnering with design, product, and data engineering to ship customer-facing analytics at Apple Services scale. Led UI engineering for the platform's largest feature expansion since launch: monetization dashboards for Subscriptions, Offers, and Cohorts, more than doubling analytical coverage with 50+ new measures and dimensions and reimagining filtering. Drove consensus across Product, Design, Data Engineering, Web API, QA, Localization, and App Store Connect.

Championed adoption of TypeScript, test automation, and browser-standard primitives. Built a containerized runner with mocks and configurable proxy unblocking and accelerating parallel work across product, design, QA, localization, and partner engineering. Shipped a custom instrumentation dashboard to measure usage and performance impact. First-adopter partner on next-generation internal design system; core contributor and maintainer of its predecessor — authored data-visualization plugins end to end and led infrastructure and tooling overhaul across core library, plugins, and docs to reduce technical debt and encourage community contribution.

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
Designed, developed, deployed and iterated on numerous public and private web applications for various Fortune 100 companies and other clients with equally varied technical solutions and tooling including containerized microservices, both custom and open source, interfacing with various internal and external APIs; implementing authentication, authorization schemes, payment processing, custom log pipelines, transactional and email notifications, stylized mapping, collaborative and dynamic interfaces, templatized pdf generation, and more with tools like shell scripts, Makefiles, golang, JSON, javascript, node.js, Typescript, php, Postgres, BoltDB, MySQL, nginx, docker, terraform and frameworks like React, Vue.js, Echo to name a few.

Designed, developed and launched Pikō: a general purpose iOS App with companion Apple Watch application utilizing location and device orientation to measure current three-dimensional positions and compute differences from other three-dimensional positions as various nautical, aeronautical and other mathematical representations.

Designed and self-published a book; all content and layout in Adobe InDesign, captured and edited all photography, coordinated printing, publishing and sales for Food Vibes: a casual but elegant and inspiring culinary catalog complemented by foodvib.es, a custom-rolled static HTML/CSS website and original open source tooling created to manage and publish the site.

positions.title: Data Visualist, Industrial Design
positions.description:
Directly supported Industrial Design with emphasis on Human Factors. Collaborated with Designers, Researchers and Engineering teams across every function of the company to collectively and iteratively explore, identify and optimize both physical and virtual product design and design processes.

- Produced compelling interactive and static visual design communications and statistical analysis summaries utilized by the Industrial and Product Design teams and directly influencing the design process and conversation for multiple successful and in-development products.

- Generated numerous three dimensional surfaces, curvature and other geometries directly supporting various products ranging from physical and virtual product features to abstract, statistical representations of various aspects of the human form in dynamic contexts.

- Architected and successfully coordinated development of a sophisticated document-oriented data structure, HTTP JSON API and internal security strategy for a standardized data warehouse and unified reporting interface for disparate experimental data.

- Designed a novel, configurable, iterative shape-fitting process that served at the center of design process for a product that was considered and queued for U.S. Patent.

positions.title: Interactive Data Engineer, Product Design
positions.description:
Directly supported Industrial Design with emphasis on Human Factors. Collaborated with Designers, Researchers and Engineering teams across every function of the company to collectively and iteratively explore, identify and optimize both physical and virtual product design and design processes.

- Developed and deployed in-house wiki and publishing platform to coordinate communication, transparency and collaboration of Human Factors related research and interactive data visualizations.

- Level of success, impact and utility in development, design, collaboration and communication warranted induction to Industrial Design team in an official capacity within three months.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Manufacturing Design
positions.description:
Founding member and lead developer, designer and architect for a software team embedded in Manufacturing Design.

- Established and grew a multi-talented software team directly supporting Manufacturing Design in addition to leading the technical architecture, design and development of a suite of web applications and distributed systems supporting the mass production of nearly every product.

- Architected, developed and deployed a state-of-the-art reverse proxy authentication micro-service interfacing with the corporate single-sign-on implementation that became a gold standard for SSO authentication for internal web services.

- Designed, developed and successfully deployed a scalable, distributed manufacturing traceability and quality control system interfacing with laser etch machines, part scanners, custom touch screens with fully customizable data collection collaboratively defined by and utilized by Apple and external suppliers in Asia including a near-realtime web-accessible dashboard and unified reporting system.

- Lead the design, codification and deployment of the standard for a distributed, machine-readable, binary part marking and identication standard that was adopted for all desktop and portable enclosures at all suppliers and considered for U.S. Patent.

- Founded and coordinated a successful internal open source software initiative and club encouraging collaboration, communication and transparency including branding, a mailing list, chat room with logs and a network of web applications and tooling for code-sharing.

positions.title: Web Developer and Designer
positions.description: Acted as lead developer and assisted with interface design utilizing PHP, HTML and JS, occasional Flash.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Designed and developed an online store. Acted as buyer, marketer, accountant, lead ui designer, lead developer, photographer, handled all legal responsibilities and logistics.
